name: Omasweeper
author: Jankees
description: Minesweeper for omarchy-shell, drawn like a TUI: a character grid on hairlines, base-36 gutter labels, ANSI numbers and a status bar. Opens as an ordinary tiled window, is fully keyboard accessible, makes 8-bit noises, and keeps the game in progress across a shell restart. Summon with: omarchy-shell shell toggle jankeesvw.omasweeper

barWidget.description: Bar icon that toggles the Omasweeper window
